plan.notes: Source: official TCU Computer Science 'BS in Computer Science (COSC) Suggested Four-Year Plan', Revised April 2026 (file COSC_4_Year_Plan_Fall_2026.pdf), hosted on serc.tcu.edu, the TCU Computer Science department site (TCU Science & Engineering Research Center). Catalog year 2026-2027. Method: the plan's Fall/Spring term grid was transcribed slot-by-slot (Freshman/Sophomore/Junior/Senior mapped to Fall/Spring Year 1-4); sequencing cross-checked against the official 'COSC Required Courses Prerequisite Graph' (Revision: April 2026, csprograms.tcu.edu). Curriculum changes vs the prior June-2024 plan: COSC 30503 Systems Programming added to sophomore fall (replacing CITE 30103 Unix/Linux System Administration); advanced-coursework rule is now 36 hours at 30000/40000 level taken at TCU (was 42); MATH 30853 may substitute for MATH 10043. Degree minimum is 120 hours; the suggested plan as transcribed totals 126 credits (assumes 4-credit lab sciences for the four NSC slots and 3-credit TCU Core/free electives; students choosing 3-credit astronomy options or bringing AP/transfer credit land at or near 120). TCU Core slots modeled at 3 cr, NSC slots at 4 cr, free electives at 3 cr. Prereqs: only directly-evidenced prerequisites are encoded - the plan's own course sequence, the April 2026 prerequisite graph (row-1 courses are prerequisite-or-corequisite for row-2 courses; COSC 30503 is taken as a corequisite with COSC 20803 in sophomore fall), the official TCU COSC 30403 syllabus (COSC 20803 and MATH 20123, C or better), and the catalog's COSC 40993 prerequisite (COSC 40943 with C- or better). The graph additionally gates COSC 30203/30603 behind the sophomore core and COSC 40403, COSC 40943, COSC 40203, COSC 40993 plus the four upper-level electives behind junior-core completion and 'Senior Standing and Last Full Year in COSC'; senior standing is not a course code so it is documented here rather than encoded. COSC 40943 and COSC 40993 are TCU Core writing-emphasis (WEM) courses. A minimum 2.2 GPA in all computer science coursework is required to graduate (per catalog). Choice slots use unique placeholder codes (never reused); tccns left blank (not published on the handout).

courses.title: Natural Science Requirement (TCU Core NSC)
courses.choice_note: Two-course sequence in Physics and Astronomy plus two approved NSC courses: PHYS 10154 + PHYS 10164, or PHYS 20474 + PHYS 20484, or any two of PHYS 10263/10273/10293, plus two additional approved natural science courses. Courses for nonscience majors may not be counted. Modeled at 4 credits (lab science).
